question:
Point A is 15 m to the west of Point C. Point B is 22 m to the north of Point C. Point D is 18 m to the east of Point B.

Point E is 11 m to the south of point D. Point X is 33 m to the west of Point E.

What is the shortest distance between Point A and Point X?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Point A is 15 m to the west of Point C.
 
• Point B is 22 m to the north of Point C.
 
• Point D is 18 m to the east of Point B.
 
• Point E is 11 m to the south of point D.
 
• Point X is 33 m to the west of Point E.

**To find: **The shortest distance between Point A and Point X.

**Explanation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64ba7d25676e4e144727242642ca2f552dc7940ace7f605f3afbe900edd0c2d.png] 

**The shortest distance between Point A and Point X is 11m.**

Hence, **11m** is the** correct answer.**
